data.text: Good, I can see the structure. Now let me run a query to calculate the revenue for both periods and compute the year-over-year growth.

args.purpose: Calculate YoY revenue growth from Jan-Aug 2017 to Jan-Aug 2018
args.sql:
WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    oi.price
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
),
revenue_by_year AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y') as year,
    SUM(price) as revenue
  FROM valid_orders
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year) as prev_year_revenue,
  (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year), 0) * 100 as yoy_growth_pct
FROM revenue_by_year
ORDER BY year;
